info.title: SinaiCamps API
info.description: Serverless API for the SinaiCamps multi-tenant hospitality marketplace (Cloudflare Worker + D1). Wire contract is camelCase end-to-end (T3); structured errors `{ success:false, error, errors? }` (T4).

Set a new password with a reset token
